history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that the Office of Information and Communications Technology conduct a cost-benefit analysis of the use of the personnel under the financial agreements with UNOPS and conduct comprehensive workforce planning to identify demands, key resources and potential risks.
history.administration_response: The Office of Information and Communications Technology conducted a review of its contractual engagements. The review included cost-benefit analysis, workforce planning, demand management, key resources and potential risks. This resulted in the Office making the transition to a new service-based model in January 2023. Financial agreements have been updated to reflect the new model. Evidence submitted shows the revised financial agreements for the current period, which reflect eight clearly defined services. The financial agreements define the roles of UNOPS and the Office and the relevant deliverables. The revised financial agreements are in line with the recently approved memorandum of understanding between the United Nations Secretariat and UNOPS. The Board’s advice will be sought regarding any additional information required to close this recommendation.
history.board_assessment: Given that a transition to a service-based model was made on the basis of the cost-benefit analysis, the Board considers the recommendation to be implemented.
